term: necessary concrete individual relative to accessibility
definition: NecessaryConcreteAt requires one fixed concrete roster member to exist actually and in every accessible world. This is de re within a supplied Kripke frame. Global all-world necessity needs coverage of every world; no essence, divine attributes or metaphysical possibility is established.
note: Analyst-defined #487 conditional semantics, not an established causal or metaphysical premise. Whole histories, rigid cross-world identity, supplied concreteness, and generic causation are independently contestable.
